articles.author: Michael Johnson, Dana Rebik
articles.title: Bears President and CEO Kevin Warren says Hammond, Indiana, is team’s ‘sole focus’ for new stadium project - WGN-TV
articles.description: As the Chicago Bears prepare to begin a much-anticipated season on the field, the team's "sole focus" for a new stadium project is on Hammond, Indiana, with two specific sites being considered near Wolf Lake, according to Bears President and CEO Kevin Warren.
